authorization_scope: Deterministic prospective-v9 semantic adjudication wrapper carried forward unchanged from v4, exact-span and route validation, auxiliary observer, blocked move-and-manner assignment at 72 dialogues over 18 batches, two separated host action families, delivered-contrast fidelity reading, production executor, endpoint, analyzer, two-sided power, and request-validator readiness only; this certificate authorizes no confirmation-model call, live study, or programme-headroom consumption.
launch_gate: v8 asks a different question from v6 and v7. Those two compared one boredom move against another. v8 compares making a boredom-directed move against making none: the move arm asks the discriminating question, and the reference arm carries on with the proof, stages the next already-public piece of evidence, names what it does not yet settle, and says nothing about the learner. The reference arm is a written instruction, not a gap, because an uninstructed tutor would improvise a reply to the boredom and the arm would become a second treatment. v7's rule that both arms share one host action family is reversed on purpose. The family, not the move instruction, is what the turn-progression contract reads, so v7's two arms were both told a final question was allowed and both asked one in 0.976 of trigger turns. From v8 the reference arm takes reanchor_public_evidence, which compiles to a declarative handoff, and the move arm takes stage_next_step, which permits the closing question. The preflight refuses any registration whose two arms come out with the same question permission. The cost is that the arms now differ in the family, the first-draft contract line, the handoff mode and the part weighting as well as in the instruction, so v8 can say that making a move mattered and cannot say that the question did the work; the whole bundle is the manipulation and the registration says so. The fidelity floor that decides the run is now the delivered contrast, counted as question marks in the tutor's own delivered trigger turn, required at 0.90 pooled and again on each arm separately. The two echoed gates that compare the study with its own copy of itself are pinned at 1, where they state that no safety override happened, and are labelled as echoes that may never be reported as readings. The test is two-sided: v7 registered one direction, measured -0.102 pointing the other way and could say nothing about it, and the reference rate here has never been measured by anything, so there is no ground to name a direction. Power at 72 is 0.973 if carrying on recovers one learner in ten, 0.730 at one in five and 0.374 at three in ten, so the 0.80 target is not reached across the plausible middle and the registration records that rather than quoting its friendliest row. The 15000-attempt programme safeguard, not the effect size, sets the size: the ledger stands at 4684, the never-exceed figure is 123 a dialogue, and 84 dialogues would need 15016. The per-dialogue ceiling was not relaxed to fit a larger run. The instrument earns no fresh accuracy claim: the sealed 55-case held-out v4 corpus is spent and permanently excluded, and its replay here makes no model call. Launch still requires the wholly fresh digest-bound HOLD request with absent create-once destinations, exact digest verification against the standing authorization, prelaunch verification of the 8856-study and 15000-programme operational safeguards, and a separately committed explicit human approval. The completed v4, v5, v6 and v7 studies, the stopped v2 cohort, and the spent v1-v4 validation corpora remain permanently excluded from every v8 outcome.
